scenes.headline: How Comet 60B cut half of every expert pool
scenes.sub: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, pruned expert by expert, then healed.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tessellate! Comet sixty B is a smaller copy of an NVIDIA vision language model. Here's what was cut.

scenes.text: Keep every layer. In each mixture-of-experts block, keep the 256 experts that matter most, narrow each one, and drop the rest.
scenes.mark: keep the 256 experts that matter most
scenes.say: The idea: keep every layer. In each expert block, keep the half that matters most, narrow each one, and drop the rest.

scenes.title: One MoE block, before and after

steps.say: A token reaches a mixture of experts block, and a router scores the experts for it.
In the parent, it picks twenty-two of five hundred and twelve small networks.
Comet keeps two hundred and fifty-six of them, and trims each one's hidden width.
The router still picks twenty-two, so a token does about the same work as before.

scenes.title: How the cut was chosen
scenes.say: The model's own config names the method.

items.say: Run sample text, images and video through it, and score each expert by what it adds.
Drop the lowest scoring half, separately in every block.
Trim the weakest channels inside each survivor, and refit what is left.
Then train it to copy the original model, and finish with reinforcement learning.

steps.label: parent
steps.say: Each router row is like a fingerprint for one expert, so matching them shows which ones survived.

steps.label: Comet
steps.say: Every block keeps its own half, scattered, in the original order. No block keeps a neat range.

scenes.title: Parameters in the checkpoint
scenes.say: Stored parameters halve. But active parameters per token barely move, because each token still visits twenty-two experts.

scenes.label: Vision and video rows that fell
scenes.say: The cost shows up in vision. Sixteen of seventeen image and video scores fall, while agent scores mostly rise.

scenes.text: Pruning experts halves the memory a mixture-of-experts model needs, while the work per token stays almost the same.
scenes.say: So pruning experts halves the memory a model like this needs, while the work per token stays almost the same.

recap: Vision pays most of the cost
scenes.say: Half the experts kept. Memory halved, compute nearly unchanged. And vision pays most of the cost.
